AI Wolf Contest

Local Organizer

I serve as a local organizer for the international AI Wolf Contest (natural language division), including AIWolfDial 2025 held with INLG 2025, and co-authored the official contest summary paper. My responsibilities include:

  • Managing and operating the competition server
  • Communicating with participants
  • Preparing and running the workshop
  • Analyzing competition results and logs (win rates, human subjective evaluation, and LLM-as-a-judge)
  • Developing tools and code related to the contest
  • Running live demonstrations of the Werewolf game at the AIWolfDial workshops held with NLP2026 (the Annual Meeting of the Association for Natural Language Processing) and JSAI 2026

Talks & Presentations

  • 3rd International AIWolfDial Workshop (INLG 2025) — presented our paper on intent-driven AIWolf agents with a hierarchical BDI model and personality
  • JSAI 2026 — presented our work on LLM tendency profiling, a 6-axis evaluation framework for multi-agent dialogue systems
  • AIWolfDial workshop at JSAI 2026 — presented the design of my competition agent

I teach NLP and programming to undergraduate students as a teaching assistant.

  • Data Processing Programming (データ処理プログラミング) — teaching assistant
